note: An inventory of retained reports, not a meta-analysis or proof that every report is comparable. Historical reports were not rerun unless marked. No complete AI-generation/task benchmark exists.

reports.scope: Persistent JSON-lines request roundtrip, includes controller JSON encoding/decoding, IPC, validation, calculation and response. Process launch, schema discovery and compilation excluded. One host, not CPU-kernel or energy measurements.

Seven rotated fresh-process trials after retained cold/warmup, one uncontrolled Mac. Includes process launch, parsing, sorting and JSON output. The old raw-global-buffer RF2 variant has different lifetime and bounds semantics; C qsort also changes the sorting algorithm. No isolated check-overhead, general speed, energy or AI-token claim.

Identical runtime inputs; seven rotated process trials after separately retained cold/warmup. Wall time includes process launch on one uncontrolled Mac. Clang loop, scalar-only loop and equally specialized closed form retained. No energy, token, full-stack or universal speed claim.

Native in-process repeated transforms with process startup included; equal input/output and checked reference semantics. Reference-only intentionally omits candidate execution/disagreement detection, so it provides fewer guarantees. Isolated benchmark code, not an unsafe production switch. No CLI parsing/hashing, no broad language comparison or token/energy measurement.

One host. Fresh-process wall time includes launch. Repeated kernels retain actual checksums. Optional optimiser compared with frozen 0.9 for identical scalar source. Token counts encode retained exchanges, not provider bills or AI task success.

Runtime inputs for every variant; fresh-process wall time includes launch. Rotated matched trials. C -O3 -mcpu=native, plus equally specialised C formula. One host, uncontrolled system load; no universal performance or AI inference claim.

One-host persistent JSON-lines roundtrip including controller serialization/result checking; startup, discovery and plan preparation excluded from latency. Token experiment includes preparation/release, schemas and exact requests/responses. No inference API invoked.

One local stdio process. Includes native parsing, execution or verification, authentication, pipes and Python host JSON serialization/deserialization. Not a network, GPU, pure engine, AI bill/token or crosslanguage result. No previous authenticated MCP baseline existed.

reports.scope: Fresh-process end-to-end wall time including startup/IO for four bounded tasks, rotated order, one uncontrolled Mac. Algorithm/library differences named explicitly. No AI model calls, bills, token, energy or universal language-speed claim.
